title: Amma's (Jan's) Granola
description: A simple homemade granola with oats, nuts, coconut, and maple syrup, baked low and slow until crisp.

steps.instruction: In a large bowl, combine rolled oats, sliced almonds, shredded coconut, and brown sugar.
In a small bowl, mix maple syrup, oil, and salt.
Pour wet ingredients over dry ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Spread mixture evenly onto a jelly roll pan.
Bake for 45–60 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes, until golden and crisp.
